name: smartcart-discount-engine
description: Opptra FDE assignment - discount engine with cart offers, NL rule input and PDF cart upload

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
